reachability.title: Reachability check
reachability.description: Requests the site's discovery files and pages on its live domains and compares the answers with what your settings expect: what should be public must answer with the right type, what is turned off or not indexable must not be served. Only the site's verified domains can be checked.

reachability.truncated: The check ran out of time: some requests were not made.
reachability.simulatedNote: Simulated results: these requests carry the crawlers' User-Agent but come from this server, so they may differ from what the real crawlers get.
